items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah. And then you played with Walter de Paris. [INTERVIEWEE] Frank -- with Frank Stewart. And

ctx.x: And then there was another job, Snaghead's Inn, and we -- I did some records with Dick Vance and Benny Morton on my own, you know, with the -- and then there was a play -- I was with a guy yesterday called Awfully Nice that I conducted. We went up to New Haven and up to Philly. It didn't go very far.
Yeah. And then you played with Walter de Paris.
